name: map

params.focus: country or state name(s) to highlight, e.g. "Telangana" or ["India", "Pakistan"] (Natural Earth English names)
params.from: "world" to fly in from the whole world (default: 4x wider than the focus)

description: Offline outline map (Natural Earth, India's point of view on borders, map.js from make_data.py): camera flies in, focus area fills in accent colour, pins pulse with labels
